props.name: accept
props.description: The `accept` attribute's syntax, such as `"image/*,.pdf"`. The picker receives it as-is, and every source enforces it: a file that fails it reaches `onReject` with `"type"`.

props.name: capture
props.description: Ask a phone to capture new media with the front (`"user"`) or back (`"environment"`) camera.

props.name: directory
props.description: The picker selects folders, and dropped folders expand into their files.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignore every source, and disable each `FileUpload.Trigger`. An enclosing disabled `Field.Root` or `Field.Set` disables the Root as well.

props.name: files
props.description: The files a native form posts, which the parent owns. The Root never changes the list: add a pick from `onSelect`, and remove files from your own UI. A native form reset leaves the list, and the post, as they are. Without a `name`, they post only under an enclosing `Field.Root`'s `name`.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Take more than one file. Without it, a pick, drop or paste of several files rejects them all with `"count"`.

props.name: name
props.description: Post `files` under this name with a native form submit or `new FormData(form)`. It needs `files`. An enclosing `Field.Root`'s `name` takes its place, as it does for Base UI's controls.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Receives the files and folders that did not pass, with the reason for each. For one pick, drop or paste it runs right after `onSelect`, in the same task.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Receives the files that passed `accept` and the count rule, in a fresh array for each call.
